plate.narration: At the edge of the Bone Yard, broken stone walls stand among enormous pale arches. Salt wind moves through the gaps. A narrow path curves between the quiet ruins.

goal.text: Clear a safe way past the displaced ruins without taking anything from the Bone Yard.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

arrival.narration: At the edge of the Bone Yard, your Skupper guide from the flats stops in a brackish pool. Broken stone walls have popped up among enormous old bones. Small bone crawlers crowd the shimmer around them. "Tonight, clear a safe way past those ruins," she says. "And take nothing. Here, anything taken comes back." One crawler is trying to hide under a pebble. It does not fit.

limit.narration: The guide points out the boundary. "My pool is outside it. The ruins are inside." She lends a marked plank and a return line. "My spare mats can cover one patch of loose stones in there," she says. "But you carry them in and out."

pack_mats.narration: Level the bundle of spare mats. Bright loops show they are the guide's, not the yard's.

interaction.cue: Level the spare mats for carrying.

onSuccess.narration: The spare mats come with you.

onFailure.narration: The spare mats come with you.

onAssisted.narration: The spare mats come with you.

leave_mats.narration: Pass the spare mats back to the guide. The loose stones inside stay uncovered.

interaction.cue: Pass the spare mats back to the guide.

onSuccess.narration: The mats stay by her pool.

onFailure.narration: The mats stay by her pool.

onAssisted.narration: The mats stay by her pool.

survey.narration: The short passage runs behind a leaning wall. A wide rim curves around a hollow. Near the wall, fresh magic draws crawlers to a tear. Watch the wall's moving shadow before you pick your ground.

survey_window.narration: Wait until the wall's shadow slides off the firm strip. The guide watches from her pool.

interaction.cue: Mark the firm strip during the clear view.

onFailure.narration: The shadow hides the strip. The guide calls the rim instead.

survey_result.narration: Both routes are drawn. The guide frowns at the short one. "That wall may block it again. Keep the rim easy to find." A crawler stands on a pebble, trying to look enormous.

markers.narration: Lay your own return line along the short passage for a quick way back, or learn the outer arches with the guide. A line left inside stays there if you retreat. The guide taps an arch. "My rim signs work even then."

lay_line.narration: Pass your marked line along the safe strip, clear of the shimmer.

interaction.cue: Pass the return line along the strip.

onSuccess.narration: Your line marks the short way back.

onFailure.narration: Your line marks the short way back.

onAssisted.narration: Your line marks the short way back.

learn_arches.narration: The guide points out three arches on the outer rim. Watch her crest signals before she ducks behind the reeds.

interaction.cue: Watch the arch route, then copy it.

onSuccess.narration: You can name the three arches.

onFailure.narration: The guide will call the arches for you.

onAssisted.narration: You can name the three arches.

test.narration: A yard pebble rolls back uphill over the boundary. Your marked plank stays where you set it. The guide raises a fin. "The yard is very particular about whose things are whose." Try a small test. Keep your pockets empty.

returning_pebble.narration: The pebble rolls behind three loose stones, and they shuffle. Watch it, then point. No picking it up.

interaction.cue: Follow the pebble through the shifting stones.

onSuccess.narration: You spot the pebble. It stays put.

onFailure.narration: The guide points it out. You fix your drawing instead.

onAssisted.narration: You spot the pebble. It stays put.

vibration.narration: Fresh magic pulses from the tear. The crawlers all turn toward it, and one trips over the next. Tap your plank between pulses. What do they do?

interaction.cue: Tap the plank in the quiet between pulses.

onSuccess.narration: The crawlers just pause at your tap.

onFailure.narration: Your tap hits a pulse. The guide calls the next gap.

onAssisted.narration: The crawlers just pause at your tap.

support.narration: A low brace will keep the leaning wall settled while you work. A fallen yard stone could do it and leave your plank free. Or wedge in your plank and fetch it later. If you retreat, a stuck plank stays inside.

stone_support.narration: Roll a fallen stone against the foot of the wall. Set it low and leave it in the yard.

onSuccess.narration: The wall leans on its own stone.

onFailure.narration: The wall leans on its own stone.

onAssisted.narration: The wall leans on its own stone.

plank_support.narration: Hold the marked plank while the guide calls out where it goes. Wedge it low, with its bright loop showing.

interaction.cue: Hold the plank while the wedge settles.

braced_support.narration: Your thornguard uses a skill called Brace to hold the wall while a fallen stone slides in low. The stone stays in the yard. Your plank stays free.

rest.narration: Back at the boundary pool, the guide opens a floating lunch box tied to a reed. "Soft seaweed rolls," she says proudly. You rest on your own mat outside the yard. The box bumps her fin every time she reaches for lunch.

plan.narration: The tear keeps drawing fresh magic and crawlers. You could clear the passage on open ground. Or mark the closing stones first, so the tear shuts faster.

plan_1.narration: You pick open ground for the fight. Nothing you knock loose goes home as a prize.

seam_marks.narration: Plan your steps around the tear. Start at the nearest closing stone. End where your Listening Chime can check for an echo of a way back.

interaction.cue: Put the closing points in order.
clues: Begin at the nearest closing stone.
The firm side ledge comes between that stone and the echo check.
Finish by checking the echo point.

onSuccess.narration: Now the tear can close in two turns.

onFailure.narration: The guide fixes the order. The crawlers still wait.

onAssisted.narration: Now the tear can close in two turns.

seam_marks_mats.narration: Plan your steps around the tear. Start at the nearest closing stone. End where your Listening Chime can check for an echo of a way back.

interaction.cue: Put the closing points in order.
clues: Begin at the nearest closing stone.
The firm side ledge comes between that stone and the echo check.
Finish by checking the echo point.

onSuccess.narration: Now the tear can close in two turns.

onFailure.narration: The guide fixes the order. The crawlers still wait.

onAssisted.narration: Now the tear can close in two turns.

lay_board_mats.narration: Lay your mats over the northern patch of loose stones. The southern stones and the crawlers are still there.

interaction.cue: Hold the mats while the northern patch is covered.

mat_plan.narration: Your mats cover the northern patch, but the southern stones can still bite. Fight now, or mark the closing stones too?

fight.narration: Bone crawlers clatter across the open passage. Stand by the tear for three turns to close it, or drive the crawlers away. The loose stones near the shimmer bite anyone who stops on them.

fight_seam.narration: Your marks show where to fold the tear shut. Stand by it for two turns to close it, or drive the crawlers away. Loose stones still bite anyone who stops on them.

fight_mats.narration: Your mats cover the northern loose stones. The southern patch still shifts, and crawlers crowd the passage. Stand by the tear for three turns to close it, or drive the crawlers clear.

fight_seam_mats.narration: Your mats cover the northern loose stones. The southern patch still shifts, and crawlers crowd the passage. Stand by the tear for two turns to close it, or drive the crawlers clear.

cleared.narration: The crawlers leave the passage, and the leaning wall stops rocking. You have room to pass. One crawler stays on a rock, still trying to look enormous.

variants.text: You closed the tear instead of chasing every crawler. With the fresh magic gone, they wander off to deeper stones.

rescued.narration: The crawlers push you back toward the boundary. Everyone pulls clear and rests out of reach. The short passage stays blocked, so the guide points out the longer rim. You lost the short way, but nobody is lost.

inventory.narration: A carved chip lies beside the path. It would fit a pocket. The guide points at the returning pebble. "Your pocket is only a delay." Before you go, check what is yours and what is the yard's.

unbrace.narration: Loose gear can come back now. Anything wedged or tied down takes extra work to free.

variants.text: The crawlers still guard the wall. Anything stuck in there stays. The guide waves you toward the longer rim.

replace_plank.narration: Set a fallen yard stone under the wall. Then slide your plank free.

interaction.cue: Settle the stone before freeing the plank.

recover_mats.narration: Hold the mat's edge while its bright loops are untied.

interaction.cue: Hold the mat while its ties come loose.

gather_loose.narration: Pass your loose gear along the outer strip. Anything stuck under a support stays where it is.

interaction.cue: Pass the loose gear along the strip.

exit_strip.narration: The boundary pool shines beyond the arches. The guide raises her crest. "Listen for my calls." Which way out?

variants.text: The crawlers still hold the short passage. The longer route is the only way past them.

outer_rim.narration: Follow the guide's calls from arch to arch around the hollow. Her pool is the last stop.

interaction.cue: Follow the outer landmarks to the pool.
clues: Start at the split arch nearest the inner approach.
The low arch lies between the split arch and the pool.
Finish outside at the boundary pool.

onSuccess.narration: You reach the pool by the outer rim.

onFailure.narration: The guide calls again. You reach her pool.

onAssisted.narration: You reach the pool by the outer rim.

return_line.narration: Hold the marked line steady as it comes in from the clear passage.

interaction.cue: Hold the line as it comes in.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone and the line are back.

onFailure.narration: Everyone and the line are back.

onAssisted.narration: Everyone and the line are back.

boundary.narration: A crumb falls from a muddy sole and rolls uphill toward the ruins. "Other foot too," says the guide. Leave the yard's tiny hitchhikers behind.

report.narration: The guide opens her warning board. You tell her about the shifting path, the firm outer way and the stones that stayed put. "A good warning tells the whole story," she says. "Even the annoying bits."

handoff.narration: The guide fishes a soggy page from her pool. An earlier note from Orin asks the Riftseekers to compare sightings at the glacier. "I can send your account with my warning," she says. "Or you can keep your own copy."

relay_account.narration: You hand the guide your account. It names your route and any gear left behind. She tucks it beside her board. It can travel, but no yard pebble goes with it as proof.

keep_account.narration: Add one true detail to your own copy. You can help travelers and still keep your page.

ending.narration: You leave the Bone Yard with no stone, bone or prize. The guide keeps her warning. Old Ossley, the river boatman, comes upriver on the next tide, and she has checked the channel to his landing. More than one road lies ahead.

variants.text: The short passage stays blocked. Your account shows the longer rim route you used.
The marked plank came back after a yard stone took its place.
The marked plank stays inside, stuck as a support.
The used mats are back outside, untied.
The used spare mats stay inside. The guide's kit is a few mats short.
Your account goes with her warning.

test_response_pebble.narration: The pebble rolls right back uphill to its hollow. The yard keeps its own things. Your gear is yours to mind.

test_response_plank.narration: Your plank stays put. The yard does not want it. The yard keeps its own things. Your gear is yours to mind.

test_response_draw.narration: The guide checks your drawing and nods. The yard keeps its own things. Your gear is yours to mind.

inventory_response_draw.narration: The chip stays put. Your drawing keeps its shape. Your packs hold only your own gear.

inventory_response_loop.narration: The guide spots her own kit at a glance. Your packs hold only your own gear.

inventory_response_sole.narration: The crumb rolls home. Your boot feels less interesting now. Your packs hold only your own gear.

boundary_response_boots.narration: The last crumbs roll back inside. No stone, bone or prize leaves with you.

boundary_response_mats.narration: Grit drops out on the yard side. No stone, bone or prize leaves with you.

boundary_response_packs.narration: Bright loops and empty pockets match your story. No stone, bone or prize leaves with you.

keep_account_response_route.narration: The page shows the way you really went. Your page stays with you. The guide keeps her own warning.

keep_account_response_rule.narration: You write what you saw, not why it happens. Your page stays with you. The guide keeps her own warning.

keep_account_response_gear.narration: The list shows anything really left behind. Your page stays with you. The guide keeps her own warning.
